meta.title: Happy Human – training that makes you happy
meta.description: Free, playful and intense functional training in Blomvåg, Norway, with personal trainer and sport scientist Kaja Haugen. For everyone, from beginner to super fit.

hero.title: Feel-good training.
hero.lead: Free, playful functional training in Blomvåg. No fitness level required – everyone's welcome.
hero.imageLabel: Blomvåg on a winter evening: houses by the bay and the sun setting over the sea
hero.imageAlt: Blomvåg on a winter evening: houses by the bay and the sun setting over the sea

why.title: Training that feels good
why.lead: No before-and-after photos, no body pressure. Just training you look forward to.

items.title: Mastery
items.text: Every exercise has an easier and a harder version, so you can always challenge yourself – at your level.

items.title: Joy of training
items.text: Playful, varied training with good vibes. You should leave happier than you arrived.

items.title: Room for everyone
items.text: From beginner to super fit. No comparing – just community.

items.title: Body and mind
items.text: Health is more than muscles. Training is about feeling good, not about how you look.

trainer.name: Kaja Haugen
trainer.role: Founder, personal trainer and sport scientist
trainer.bio: A personal trainer and group instructor for over seven years, with a master's in sport science from the Norwegian School of Sport Sciences. Today she works at Anti-Doping Norway. Kaja is passionate about training that does you good – body and mind.
trainer.quote: My goal is for you to feel mastery and joy in training.
trainer.title: Your coach is a sport scientist
trainer.why: Kaja has seen how thoughts about body, food and training can turn harmful. That's why she builds training around joy, community and feeling that you can do it.

items.q: Do I need to be fit?
items.a: No! Every exercise has an easier and a harder version, so the class works for everyone – from beginner to super fit.
Join the Facebook group. Kaja posts new sessions there, and you just mark whether you're coming.
Nothing. The group classes are free, and they will stay that way.
Yes! No babysitter? Bring the kids and we'll adapt as we go. Sometimes there's a playdate for the little ones too.

items.q: Where and when do you train?
items.a: In the gym hall at Blomvåg kindergarten in winter, and outdoors when the weather allows. Times are posted in the group, often weekdays at 17:30 or Saturdays at 10:00.
Workout clothes, shoes and water. Feel free to bring a friend.
It's coming. Personal training with Kaja will be a paid service – follow the group to hear when it opens.

finalCta.lead: Find the next session in the group – come on your own or bring a friend. There's room for everyone.

session.title: How a class works
session.lead: We start together, work through stations and finish with something fun. You decide how hard it gets.
session.diagramLabel: People arriving on their own, coming together in the warm-up and spreading out across the stations

steps.title: Come as you are
steps.text: On your own, with a friend or with the kids. A tick in the Facebook group is all it takes.

steps.title: Warm up together
steps.text: Get your heart rate up, have a laugh and play a bit, so your body is ready for the rest of the class.

steps.title: Find your level
steps.text: 8–10 stations with an easier and a harder version, and something playful to finish.

stations.title: Choose your level
stations.lead: Every exercise has an easier and a harder version, so the class works for beginners and the super fit alike.
stations.note: An example class. Kaja puts together new stations every time. Take breaks when you need to, and stop if anything hurts.

items.name: Squats
items.easier: Sit down on a bench and stand up again slowly.
items.harder: Jump squats with a soft landing.

items.name: Push-ups
items.easier: Against the wall or with your knees on the mat.
items.harder: With your feet up on a box.

items.name: Lunges
items.easier: Short steps, with one hand on the wall for balance.

items.name: Plank
items.easier: On your knees, for as long as it feels good.
items.harder: With alternating arm and leg lifts.

items.name: Kettlebell swing
items.easier: A light bell and short swings.
items.harder: A heavier bell, swung up to chest height.

items.name: Jump rope
items.easier: Light bounces on your toes, or march on the spot.
items.harder: Quick jumps with a rope – try getting it round twice per jump.

items.name: Mountain climbers
items.easier: Slow pace with your hands on a bench.
items.harder: Fast pace with your hands on the floor.

items.name: Mobility
items.easier: Cat-cow (round and arch your back on all fours) and gentle hip circles.
items.harder: Deep lunge with an upper-body twist.
